reviews.comment: TAKE ANY AND EVERY GIST COURSES YOU CAN WITH DR. LEE!! He is so good at explaining technical concepts and truly cares about the student learning experience. Dudes the GOAT
great prof. Very knowledgeable and passionate about remote sensing. Course was difficult but show up to class and you'll do good

Very approachable and personable professor. He makes sure you grasp the main points of the lectures, and some of them can be dense. But he keeps lectures engaging. Exams are open book but you only get 50 minutes to do the midterm!!

I am currently taking and thoroughly enjoying GEO361 with Dr. Lee. Remote sensing is not an easy topic to learn but he makes difficult concepts easy to digest and keeps lectures engaged. His exams are a little tough but he spends an entire lecture after to go through concepts you didn't understand and gives you points back.

Dr. Lee makes very technical topics approachable and easy to understand. I love his teaching style. Labs were a bit time consuming but graded rather generously by the TA's. Show up and you'll do great in this class

As a graduating senior, def top 3 professors I've had. 
I'd rate Dr. Lee a 5 but I'd say the course is a solid 3.5. Like another review said some labs were unclear and difficult. I wouldn't blame him since its his first semester here and took over the course. 
Otherwise, he's very helpful if you need clarification and he's an engaging lecturer

Your grade in this class honestly depends on your TA, unless you're really good with software/GIS. Labs were hard and had confusing instructions. Some were out of date, and we had to use 4 different software programs (CAD, ArcGIS Online/Field Maps, DroneDeploy, and Pix4DMapper). Exam questions were pretty hard, especially on the first exam.

Dr.Lee was such a great professor! He makes sure you grasp the main points in lecture and he's more than happy to answer any questions you may have over the course content. The labs are probably the most time consuming unless you're very good with GIS, but they were graded generously. Exams were pretty straightforward!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class
